problem_type: Repeated read-only storyboard corrections and serial batch ETA projection
symptom: Eight identical missing-model corrections render as eight warning rows, and an eight-shot confirmation estimates eight sequential task durations despite concurrency six.
direct_cause: StoryboardPlanStrategyPanel maps blockers one-for-one; coldstartEtaForGate multiplies the single-task interval by shotCount without batch rounds.
class_root: Shared read-only projections do not preserve the identity of equivalent corrections or the scheduler's concurrency invariant.
affected_population: Storyboard plans with repeated model corrections
internal_only_reason: Both invariants are application projections defined by the existing plan resolver and scheduler contracts; no third-party behavior determines them.
invariants: Equivalent issue code plus original model plus target model produces one warning with all affected shots.
Cold-start ETA uses ceil(task count / scheduler concurrency) rounds times the single-task low/high interval.
generality_proof: All storyboard blocker rows pass through aggregateIssues before rendering, and all multi-shot cold-start receipts pass through coldstartEtaForGate at the shared planning boundary.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Groups equivalent structured issues while retaining shot identities.
Converts task count and concurrency into ETA rounds.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All visible blocker rows now consume aggregateIssues output.
The receipt calls coldstartEtaForGate with the batch scheduler default concurrency of six.

recurrence.reason: Any repeated structured issue or batch size can reproduce the projection error.
same_class_scan: rg for modelMissing/blockers in storyboard editor
rg for coldstartEtaForGate/waitSeconds in generation planning and tests
checked strategy panel and multi-shot receipt assembly

prevention.invariant: Projection identity and scheduler concurrency are applied before UI serialization.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown issue fields remain separate; invalid concurrency is clamped to one round worker.
prevention.strategy: Keep aggregation and round calculation pure and covered by class tests.

legacy_paths.rationale: The old projection behavior is replaced in the same shared boundaries.

migration: No persisted data or plan writes change; this is a read-only projection adjustment.
residual_risks: Historical ETA samples are not yet available, so cold-start ranges remain conservative profile-based intervals.
